label: Complete
definition: Data are present and sufficiently comprehensive for use.
notes: Data in a bdqffdq:InformationElement are present and sufficiently comprehensive for use. Corresponding dimension is bdqdim:Completeness.

label: Consistent
definition: Data are internally consistent and consistent with any authorities consulted.
notes: A set of bdqffdq:InformationElements and bdqval:sourceAuthorities are consistent. Corresponding dimension is bdqdim:Consistency.

label: Found
definition: Data conform to the values in an authority.
notes: Data in a bdqffdq:InformationElement conform to a bdqval:sourceAuthority. Corresponding dimension is bdqdim:Conformance.

label: In Range
definition: Data conform to an expected range of values.
notes: Data in a bdqffdq:InformationElement conform to an expected range of values. Corresponding dimension is bdqdim:Conformance.

label: Likely
definition: Data are likely to be true or expected values.
notes: Data in a bdqffdq:InformationElement is likely to be true or expected values. Corresponding dimension is bdqdim:Likeliness.

label: Not Empty
notes: Some value is present in a bdqffdq:InformationElement. Corresponding dimension is bdqdim:Completeness. See also bdqval:Empty and bdqval:NotEmpty.

label: Standard
definition: Data conform to a format, syntax, data type, or standard.
notes: Data in a bdqffdq:InformationElement conform to a format, syntax, data type, or standard. Corresponding dimension is bdqdim:Conformance.

label: Unambiguous
definition: Data adequately identify a unique entity.
notes: Data in a bdqffdq:InformationElement adequately identifies a unique entity. Corresponding dimension is bdqdim:Conformance.
